# 0.9.0-beta03

> **Beta.** Tested on a real phone, but still report what breaks on GitHub. Installs as **Editotsu β** and updates beta02 in place.

- **New Features:**
  - Covers show your episode or chapter count in the corner ("2 | 11"); Appearance > Episode count can move it under the title or show only new episodes
  - The seek bar shows how much of the video is loaded, and Player settings has a buffer size choice
  - One sheet for genres and tags: tap once to include, twice to leave out, and search inside it
  - News is a feed grouped by month, with video thumbnails
  - Openings & endings has a cleaner top bar and actions
  - Spoilers over several lines are hidden until you tap them
  - Status bar icons stay readable over artwork and on light themes
  - Two-way switches keep their icon when selected, and labels no longer get cut off

- **Bugfixes:**
  - The loading spinner no longer stays over a video that is already playing
  - Resuming an episode no longer flashes the start of the video first
  - MyAnimeList sync no longer changes anything when AniList didn't answer
  - Restoring a backup no longer sends its old progress to your list
  - Long-pressing an episode or chapter asks before marking it watched or read, and names the one you pressed
  - Finishing chapter 1 with chapter zero on saves 1, not 0
  - Turned-off home rows stay hidden
  - Rescue Mode can't be turned on without a MyAnimeList account
  - Fixed crashes: rotating the custom colour picker, a % in a custom user agent, tapping a recommendation in Rescue Mode, the torrent server after a day of use on Android 15
  - The donate prompt shows at most once a month
  - The source picker uses the app font on its chips and tags
  - Deleting a downloaded title with special characters in its name deletes the right thing
  - Adult sources show up without restarting the app
  - The download queue shows manga progress
  - A damaged downloads list no longer crashes the app on start
  - Downloaded novel chapters each keep their own reading position

- **Known issues:**
  - If the AniList sign-in page sticks on the security check, tap the browser icon at the top to finish signing in
  - Watch order can say "No Watch Order Found" when the order site is busy; try again a bit later
  - A torrent you haven't played before can take a while to start on a slow swarm, and long seeks are slow
  - AnimeThemes can take up to a minute the first time you open a show
  - Not redesigned yet: the scanlator filter, episode options, the comments header, and the profile, activity and offline pages
  - The Degoogle'd build has no in-app updater
  - Pink light theme is low contrast in places
